message: Hi, I'm interested in the T25 Compact with delivery and setup. My budget is around $23,000 total. Can you do $23,000 for T25 + delivery?

Thanks for your interest in the T25 Compact. It's a great fit for smaller properties. Unfortunately $23,000 is too low for the tractor plus delivery and setup. The list price for that package is $29,400. I can do the T25 with delivery and on-site setup for $28,400. That includes delivery within 150 miles, setup, and a full walkthrough of the machine.
Thanks. Heartland Tractor posts the T25 at $27,650 and delivery at $875, so your offer isn't competitive yet. I'm not in a rush. I can do $24,500 for the T25 with delivery and setup.

I appreciate you sharing that, and I understand you're comparing options. I can't verify another dealer's pricing, but I do want to earn your business. $24,500 doesn't work for the T25 with delivery and setup. I can come down to $27,200 for the T25 Compact with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a full walkthrough. That's $2,200 off the list package price.
We're getting closer. I can go to $25,000 for the T25 with delivery and setup, payable in full today.

Thanks for moving up, and I appreciate the readiness to pay in full today. I can meet you closer to the middle: $26,300 for the T25 Compact with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a full walkthrough. That's $3,100 off the list package price and a strong value for a 25 hp 4WD hydrostatic machine set up and ready to work.
I can stretch to $25,400 all-in for the T25 with delivery and setup. That's my limit; otherwise I'll wait.
You've got a deal. $25,400 all-in for the T25 Compact with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a full walkthrough. Thanks for working with us, and enjoy the new tractor.
